channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Citrix
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Citrix, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch: Citrix NetScaler: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
item.description:
Citrix NetScaler: Denial of service · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 14.1-73.41, 13.1-64.28, 14.1-73.41 FIPS

First step: Update Citrix NetScaler to the fixed version for your release line (for example 14.1-73.41, 13.1-64.28 or 14.1-73.41 FIPS).

Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-88779

item.title: Keep patched: Citrix NetScaler: 2 flaws exploited together
item.description:
Citrix NetScaler: RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 14.1-73.37, 13.1-64.23, 14.1-73.37 FIPS

First step: Update Citrix NetScaler to the fixed version for your release line (for example 14.1-73.37, 13.1-64.23 or 14.1-73.37 FIPS).

Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. CISA lists 1 more flaw in Citrix NetScaler as exploited on the same day (CVE-2026-88772).

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-88771, CVE-2026-88772

item.title: Keep patched: Citrix NetScaler: Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel
item.description:
Citrix NetScaler: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 13.1-37.277, 13.1-63.21, 14.1-73.32

First step: Update Citrix NetScaler to the fixed version for your release line (for example 13.1-37.277, 13.1-63.21 or 14.1-73.32).

Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-19490
